# CONSOLIDATA
Canonical: https://cdatats.com/
Language: English
Audience: owners of already-selling businesses in the United States and Canada with inconsistent marketing results or slowing growth.
Marketing Checkup: USD47 once plus applicable tax. Ten selected-answer questions and optional notes. Answer and review first, then create a limited preview on the server. Full report uses fixed rules: described strengths, unknowns, up to three priorities, actions and answer summary. Notes accompany findings as context without changing them.
Entry: https://cdatats.com/assessment.html — noindex questionnaire, limited preview, required work-email save, separate US$47 purchase review, then server-created Stripe checkout when configured. An old /checkout.html entry redirects to the questionnaire. Saving email does not create a payment session, send mail or subscribe the visitor to marketing. Payment verification is server-side; a browser return never establishes payment.
Delivery: complete report only as a PDF email attachment after verified payment. No public full-report display, download or export endpoint. Opaque browser session reference restores status only. Payment and email-delivery statuses remain distinct; email service acceptance does not guarantee inbox arrival.
Availability: checkout readiness is controlled by /api/checkup/config. Missing verified payment/email configuration disables purchase. Text questions are available; no live voice or external AI feature is promised.
Limitations: self-reported information, no independent account audit, no guaranteed cause, campaign performance, sales or profit. Further services and calls separately agreed; purchase does not subscribe to marketing.
Terms: https://cdatats.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://cdatats.com/privacy.html
Contact: alvinj@consolidatats.com

Assessment-first B: homepage and action buttons contain no prices. POST /api/checkup/email saves the work email without payment or email delivery. US$47 one time plus applicable tax is disclosed in the separate purchase review before secure payment. Only the opaque assessment reference is kept in browser session storage.
